headline: World's top 10 sovereign wealth funds hold $12.52 trillion in assets
summary: The world's 10 largest sovereign wealth funds collectively hold approximately $12.52 trillion in assets, led by Norway's Government Pension Fund Global at $2.50 trillion.
why: Sovereign wealth funds act as major institutional investors globally, influencing long-term asset allocations, equity markets, and cross-border capital flows.
